description: Khối cũ: các thẻ tầm nhìn và sứ mệnh.

visionText.default: Become Southeast Asia’s leading music ecosystem; exporting Vietnamese music to the world through innovation, creativity, and technology.

missionText.default: Our mission is to cultivate a sustainable, forward-thinking music ecosystem by empowering artists, strengthening partnerships, and fostering industry innovation. We are committed to delivering creative, impactful solutions and building a vibrant community that elevates Vietnamese music worldwide.

uspText.default: Our unique position as a music ecosystem is driven by three core pillars setting us apart from the rest. As the top music company in Vietnam, we deliver bold music experiences through innovation, tech-powered strategy, data and local insights, and artist first solutions.
